short_description: Christie Eclipse-based Dolby Vision system rolling out from May 2025. Matches or exceeds dual-laser E3LH brightness (~31 fL; community reports confirm 'just over twice typical cinema'). Single projector on screens up to 58 ft wide.

default_projection.effective_resolution_label: Christie Eclipse-based 4K RGB pure laser; ~25,000–30,000 lumens; rolling out from May 2025
default_projection.contrast_notes: Christie Eclipse-based system: Dolby official announcement states 'well exceeding 1,000,000:1'; Christie Eclipse spec sheet lists 20,000,000:1. Brightness ~31 fL based on firsthand reports from AMC Southlands (first US install, May 2025) confirming 'just over twice the brightness of the former dual-laser system.' Dolby states '>2× typical cinema' implying >28 fL from 14 fL DCI baseline. Screen max 58 ft wide for single-projector configuration.

known_limitations: Screen width capped at 58 ft for single-projector configuration — largest Dolby Cinema screens (>58 ft) will retain dual-laser E3LH
Cannot display 1.43:1 IMAX content at full height
